== Notes ==
* Mind Wrack only deals damage for the energy loss it causes, not for energy loss caused by other skills.
* Works well with [[Aneurysm]] because Mind Wrack causes energy loss and notifies you when the target has no energy, also adding damage to the [[spike]].
* The target's energy must drop to 0 to trigger the effect. Energy lost [[Energy#Regeneration_and_degeneration|while having less than 0 energy]] does not trigger Mind Wrack.
* This hex will end on the target if the caster [[Death|dies]].
